headline: A day of statements and positioning rather than awards, with no new KSA/GCC data-centre build or large KSA IT contract first published in the window. HUMAIN CEO Tareq Amin said about 14 GW of power has been allocated to HUMAIN AI factories, naming Amazon and a joint AMD project but no server OEM, while stc disclosed 53% local content against a 41% sector benchmark. In the UAE, Core42 signed a Secret/Top-Secret sovereign AI cloud MoU and Mubadala brought Together AI to Abu Dhabi. Memory keeps tightening: server DDR5 RDIMM 32GB averaged $2,050, Samsung says HBM takes nearly 30% of DRAM wafers in 2027, and Micron reports on 30 Sep.
lenovo_read: ISG must get onto the AMD rack bill of materials at HUMAIN and into Together AI and Core42 builds before hardware is named; IDG and SSG need the Alat-made ThinkPad certified for local content as stc makes it a scored criterion; memory, not demand, now sets who wins Q4 and H1 2027 deals.

pillars.dc: No new KSA/GCC build, groundbreaking, land allocation or PPA first published in window; scored HUMAIN 14 GW allocation, Mubadala–Together AI, MGX Stack APAC bid, Kuwait National Data Center tender, Qura Energy–TMEIC and Samsung–Helix (KIA-backed); Lenovo–MemryX and Edarat–MIS rejected as reposts.
pillars.memory: 7 scored items led by server DDR5 RDIMM at $2,050 and TrendForce 2027 HBM ASP +121%; no new conventional contract print, latest reference TrendForce 4Q26 (24 Sep) NAND +15–20% QoQ; DRAMeXchange spot 29 Sep DDR5 16Gb $57.833, DDR4 16Gb 3200 $83.660; Micron reports 30 Sep.
pillars.deals: 7 scored items (Core42–CSC, Mubadala–Together AI, NTT DOCOMO BUSINESS–stc, Nokia–Zain KSA, HPE–Saudi German Health UAE, Qura Energy–TMEIC, Kuwait NDC tender); no large KSA tech award and no hardware supplier named in any in-window META deal.
pillars.global: Scored Qualcomm, Nokia, HPE, AMD and Amazon moves in META; Chinese-rule news from Huawei, Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, Xiaomi, OPPO, Hisense and Lenovo; nothing verifiable from vivo, Honor (pre-window), Hikvision or ZTE.

stories.title: «هيوماين»: السعودية تخصص 14 غيغاواط لمصانع الذكاء الاصطناعي
stories.published: Asharq Al-Awsat (Arabic), 29 Sep 2026 13:34 (page timestamp). A companion interview in the same paper is stamped 12:18.
stories.summary: HUMAIN CEO Tareq Amin, speaking at a Riyadh economic forum, said about 14 GW of energy capacity has been allocated for HUMAIN's "AI factories" with the Energy Ministry. HUMAIN has signed with Amazon and is advancing a joint project with AMD, while recruiting other global firms. It is building the whole stack, from energy and data centres to models and applications, and develops its software in-house rather than buying it.
bullets: قال الرئيس التنفيذي لـ«هيوماين» طارق أمين إن التعاون مع وزارة الطاقة وجهات حكومية أسهم في تسريع تخصيص الأراضي والبنية التحتية، مع تخصيص نحو 14 غيغاواط من قدرات الطاقة للموقع الذي تعمل عليه الشركة
وقّعت الشركة اتفاقات مع جهات دولية من بينها «أمازون»، بينما تتقدّم أعمال مشروع مشترك مع شركة «إيه إم دي (AMD)»
أوضح أمين أن الشركة بنت خلال نحو 15 شهراً أعمالاً تغطي عدداً من القطاعات، واتخذت قراراً استراتيجياً بعدم شراء البرمجيات الجاهزة وتطوير أنظمتها داخلياً
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: The allocation is a stated power envelope, not built capacity. It is still the largest sovereign compute runway in META, and no server OEM is named. Undisclosed → open ISG opportunity. The AMD joint project is the entry point: Lenovo's AMD Instinct and EPYC platforms, with Neptune liquid cooling, must be in that design before a rack standard is fixed. The in-house software stance means HUMAIN buys infrastructure and integration, not packaged software.
stories.arabic: الرئيس التنفيذي لهيوماين: تخصيص نحو 14 غيغاواط لمصانع الذكاء الاصطناعي في المملكة، مع شراكات قائمة مع أمازون ومشروع مشترك مع AMD، دون الإعلان عن مورد الخوادم.

stories.title: مجموعة «stc» تحقق 53 % محتوى محلياً متجاوزة معيار قطاع الاتصالات
stories.published: Asharq Al-Awsat (business section), 29 Sep 2026 12:27 KSA (page). Maal and Zawya carried it later the same day. The original stc release was not found.
stories.summary: stc group's local content reached 53%, against the 41% telecom-sector benchmark set by the Local Content and Government Procurement Authority (LCGPA). Its June sustainability report showed 50.69%. The increase is driven by stc's Rawafed localisation programme.
bullets: ارتفعت نسبة المحتوى المحلي لمجموعة «stc» إلى 53 في المائة عام 2026، متجاوزة المعيار المرجعي لقطاع الاتصالات وتقنية المعلومات الذي حددته هيئة المحتوى المحلي والمشتريات الحكومية عند 41 في المائة
واصلت نسبة المحتوى المحلي للمجموعة ارتفاعها على مدى السنوات الـ5 الماضية، مدفوعة بتنامي الاعتماد على المنتجات والخدمات والكفاءات المحلية في العمليات وسلاسل الإمداد
يُعدّ برنامج «روافد» ركيزة أساسية لتعظيم الإنفاق المحلي وتعزيز الابتكار وجذب الاستثمارات وإثراء الكفاءات الوطنية
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG/SSG: stc and solutions by stc are among Lenovo's largest KSA channels and customers. A telco publicising local-content scores will weight them in supplier evaluation. The Alat-made ThinkPad (31 Aug) is Lenovo's lever. It must be certified by LCGPA and registered in Rawafed before HPE or Dell make the same claim.
stories.arabic: مجموعة stc ترفع نسبة المحتوى المحلي إلى 53% متجاوزة معيار القطاع البالغ 41%، ما يعزز وزن المحتوى المحلي في قرارات الشراء لدى مورديها.

stories.title: Qualcomm views Saudi AI boom as opportunity for industrial tech and power efficiency
stories.published: Arab News, 28 Sep 2026 23:03 KSA (page).
stories.summary: Qualcomm CFO Akash Palkhiwala and data-centre head Tony Pialis, speaking at the Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii, said the company is pitching low-power data-centre chips to HUMAIN, and that Saudi hyperscalers want several chip options. Qualcomm enabled Aramco Digital's private industrial 5G network on 450 MHz, since extended to AI-powered safety and security surveillance. Robotics and humanoids are named as the next opportunity.
bullets: Qualcomm CFO Akash Palkhiwala, speaking at the Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii, highlighted sovereign data centers, where hyperscalers like Humain seek extremely low-power solutions, and industrial applications with partners such as Saudi Aramco

Qualcomm enabled Aramco Digital's private industrial 5G network on 450 megahertz, and the partnership has expanded to AI-powered surveillance identifying security threats such as unauthorized access or workers lacking safety equipment
Palkhiwala identified robotics as highly promising for Middle East deployment, citing regional climate conditions, wealth levels and labor scarcity
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: Qualcomm is a partner on Snapdragon PCs but a potential rival in inference racks. HUMAIN's multi-vendor chip appetite (NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm) favours an OEM that can ship several accelerators on one platform. That is Lenovo's pitch against single-silicon stacks. The Aramco industrial AI work is a ThinkEdge opening.
stories.arabic: كوالكوم تعرض رقائق مراكز بيانات منخفضة الاستهلاك على هيوماين وتوسع حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي الصناعي مع أرامكو، في ظل طلب سعودي على تعدد موردي الرقائق.

stories.title: Nokia improves network performance and efficiency for Zain KSA across Saudi Arabia
stories.published: Nokia via GlobeNewswire, 29 Sep 2026 03:00 ET = 10:00 KSA (release page).
stories.summary: Zain KSA has deployed Nokia Deepfield Cloud Intelligence across its network in more than 100 Saudi cities. It gives real-time, application-level traffic visibility across 30+ categories using 100+ AI/ML rules. No value disclosed.
bullets: Zain KSA has launched Nokia Deepfield Cloud Intelligence across its network covering more than 100 cities in Saudi Arabia, providing real-time, end-to-end visibility
Central to the solution is Deepfield Cloud Genome, a continuously updated map of the internet that identifies applications and services across more than 30 categories using over 100 AI/ML rules
The deployment lets Zain KSA identify congestion or latency issues before they affect customers and builds an AI-ready data foundation aligned with Saudi Vision 2030
stories.lenovo: ISG: Nokia is not a compute competitor. The deployment shows Zain KSA investing in AI-driven network analytics, which needs on-premises compute and storage. Zain KSA is still an under-penetrated ISG telco account; OPP-004 is open.
stories.arabic: زين السعودية تنشر حلول نوكيا Deepfield لتحليل الشبكة بالذكاء الاصطناعي في أكثر من 100 مدينة سعودية.

stories.title: NTT DOCOMO BUSINESS and stc group launch IoT connectivity solution for Komatsu construction equipment in Saudi Arabia
stories.source: Business Wire (ID 20260928016604) and the NTT press release (0929_2). Syndicated copies appear 29 Sep about 07:00 KSA. The Business Wire page returned 403.
stories.published: Business Wire (ID 20260928016604) and the NTT press release (0929_2). Syndicated copies appear 29 Sep about 07:00 KSA. The Business Wire page returned 403.
stories.summary: NTT DOCOMO BUSINESS designs and delivers an IoT connectivity service for Komatsu's KOMTRAX equipment telematics in the Kingdom. stc supplies SIMs, in-country connectivity and its connectivity-management platform, keeping the service compliant with Saudi telecom rules. No value disclosed.
bullets: NTT DOCOMO BUSINESS and stc group launched an IoT connectivity solution for Komatsu construction equipment in Saudi Arabia, supporting Komatsu's Komtrax telematics and remote monitoring system

NTT DOCOMO BUSINESS handled solution design and end-to-end delivery, while stc group provided local expertise, connectivity services and technology, including SIMs and its Connectivity Management Platform
The solution provides regulatory-aligned, in-country connectivity in a country that restricts long-term roaming or permanent telecom services by unlicensed foreign operators
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: there is no IT hardware in scope. It confirms stc as the in-country platform that foreign industrial firms plug into, and giga-project construction fleets as an IoT/edge vertical (ThinkEdge gateways).
stories.arabic: إن تي تي دوكومو ومجموعة stc تطلقان حلاً لربط معدات كوماتسو للبناء بإنترنت الأشياء داخل المملكة وفق الأنظمة المحلية.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Strengthens Framework for Responsible AI Use
stories.published: SPA (English), 29 Sep 2026 03:24 KSA (SPA stamp).
stories.summary: SPA summarised SDAIA's AI governance set: the AI Ethics Principles, the AI Adoption Framework, generative-AI guidelines for government, the National AI Index and the National AI Risk Management Framework. It is a restatement; nothing new is launched.
bullets: Saudi Arabia has strengthened its national framework for governing the responsible use of AI, led by the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA), through regulations, policies and ethical principles

The framework includes the AI Ethics Principles, AI Adoption Framework, Generative Artificial Intelligence Guidelines for Government, National Occupational Standard Framework for Data and AI, and the National AI Index (NAII)

SDAIA has also launched the National AI Risk Management Framework, a unified national methodology for identifying, assessing, addressing and monitoring AI-related risks for government and private-sector entities
stories.lenovo: SSG/ISG: these frameworks are the compliance checklist for government AI buyers. Lenovo's AI governance and on-premises "AI where the data lives" messaging should map to them explicitly.
stories.arabic: سدايا تستعرض منظومة حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في المملكة: مبادئ الأخلاقيات وإطار التبني وإرشادات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي وإطار إدارة المخاطر.

stories.title: Core42 and CSC sign MoU to advance Signature Sovereign AI Cloud in the UAE
stories.source: Zawya 29 Sep 12:43 KSA; TahawulTech 12:59 KSA (Google News timestamps; the page shows 29 Sep).
stories.published: Zawya 29 Sep 12:43 KSA; TahawulTech 12:59 KSA (Google News timestamps; the page shows 29 Sep).
stories.summary: Core42 (G42) and the UAE Cyber Security Council signed an MoU to advance Core42's Signature sovereign AI cloud for Secret and Top-Secret government and regulated workloads. It builds on Core42's Signature Private Cloud. The MoU also covers workshops, training and threat awareness. No value disclosed. Signed at GISEC Global 2026 (16–18 Sep); first published in window.
bullets: Core42, a G42 subsidiary, signed an MoU with the UAE Cyber Security Council at GISEC Global 2026, signed by CSC Head Dr. Mohamed Hamad Al Kuwaiti and Core42 CEO Talal M. Al Kaissi
Signature Sovereign AI Cloud targets government entities and regulated industries, supporting organizations processing Secret and Top-Secret workloads
The agreement also covers cybersecurity knowledge sharing, threat awareness, technical engagement and preparedness activities including workshops, training programs and conferences
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: classified sovereign clouds need air-gapped, certified on-premises infrastructure. Hardware undisclosed → open ISG opportunity. It is also the template HUMAIN and SDAIA-backed clouds may copy in KSA.
stories.arabic: كور42 ومجلس الأمن السيبراني الإماراتي يوقعان مذكرة تفاهم لتطوير سحابة ذكاء اصطناعي سيادية لأعباء العمل الحكومية السرية.

stories.title: Mubadala and Together AI Partner to Explore AI Infrastructure Opportunities in the UAE
stories.source: Mubadala press release dated 29 Sep 2026. Earliest press pickup is Erem Business at 10:42 KSA.
stories.published: Mubadala press release dated 29 Sep 2026. Earliest press pickup is Erem Business at 10:42 KSA.
stories.summary: Mubadala and Together AI will explore AI infrastructure opportunities in the UAE through the Mubadala UAE Investments Platform. Together AI will establish a local presence in Abu Dhabi, bringing its inference and research capabilities closer to regional demand. It follows Mubadala's $100 million participation in Together AI's Series C (1 Jul 2026). No MW, sites or new investment are named.
bullets: Mubadala Investment Company and Together AI announced a strategic partnership to explore AI infrastructure and ecosystem opportunities in the UAE
Together AI will establish a local presence in Abu Dhabi, bringing its inference and research capabilities closer to regional demand and developers
The collaboration follows Mubadala's $100 million participation in Together AI's Series C financing round announced on July 1, 2026
stories.lenovo: ISG: Together AI is a GPU cloud (neocloud) buyer. A UAE build will need GPU servers, storage and liquid cooling, and the hardware supplier is undisclosed → open ISG opportunity. Mubadala's platform is the gatekeeper.
stories.arabic: مبادلة وتوغيذر إيه آي تستكشفان فرص البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي في الإمارات، مع افتتاح حضور محلي للشركة في أبوظبي.

stories.title: MGX looks for data center assets in the Asia Pacific
stories.published: Semafor, 28 Sep 2026 09:49 EDT = 16:49 KSA (page).
stories.summary: The AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock, with Abu Dhabi's MGX) and Australia's IFM are in exclusive talks for Stack Infrastructure's Asia-Pacific data centres (Tokyo, Osaka, Melbourne, Sydney, Johor), valued at up to $25bn (estimate). The piece says the first 250 MW of the Stargate UAE cluster is due to finish this year. Caveat: the exclusive-talks news was reported earlier elsewhere; Semafor's piece is first published in window.
bullets: MGX is part of the BlackRock-backed AI Infrastructure Partnership, which alongside Australia's IFM Investors is in exclusive talks for Stack Infrastructure's Asia Pacific data center portfolio
The portfolio could be valued at up to $25 billion and includes sites in Australia, Japan and Malaysia; Stack is owned by Blue Owl Capital
MGX also backs the Stargate initiative, with Abu Dhabi's first 250-megawatt Stargate cluster expected to be completed this year
stories.lenovo: ISG: Gulf AI capital is buying capacity abroad, not only at home. MGX-controlled platforms become global accounts: relationships built with MGX/G42 in Abu Dhabi can carry into APAC colocation fit-outs.
stories.arabic: إم جي إكس الإماراتية ضمن تحالف يتفاوض حصرياً على أصول مراكز بيانات ستاك في آسيا والمحيط الهادئ بقيمة تصل إلى 25 مليار دولار.

stories.title: Data center tender awaits CAPT nod
stories.published: Arab Times (Kuwait), 28 Sep 2026. Google News indexed it at 22:06 KSA; the page shows the date only.
stories.summary: Kuwait's Central Agency for Information Technology (CAIT) is waiting for the Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) to approve a tender for a consultant to design the RFP and technical specifications for the National Data Center and supervise its build. CAPT deferred its decision on 20 Sep and asked CAIT for a formal amendments letter within 5 working days. No value disclosed.
bullets: The Central Agency for Information Technology (CAIT) is seeking CAPT approval to procure consultancy services to design specifications and an RFP for the National Data Center and supervise its implementation
At a September 20 meeting, CAPT postponed its decision and asked CAIT to submit formal amendments within five working days
A 2015 Council of Ministers resolution mandated the center and requires government entities to host backup systems there to restore services after primary system failures
stories.lenovo: ISG: the consultant will write the hardware specification. Hardware undisclosed → open ISG opportunity, but only if Lenovo reaches the consultant bidders before the RFP is drafted.
stories.arabic: الجهاز المركزي لتكنولوجيا المعلومات في الكويت ينتظر موافقة جهاز المناقصات على مناقصة استشاري لتصميم وإشراف مركز البيانات الوطني.

stories.title: Saudi German Health UAE transforms digital healthcare in the UAE with the HPE Self-Driving Network
stories.published: Zawya, 29 Sep 2026 12:37 KSA (Google News timestamp).
stories.summary: Saudi German Health UAE selected HPE's wired, wireless and NAC networking, managed via HPE Aruba Central, to modernise its network across hospitals, clinics, medical education facilities and a new medical college in the UAE. The deployment uses HPE Aruba Networking access points, CX switches, gateways, ClearPass Policy Manager and User Experience Insight. HPE and Saudi German Health UAE have partnered for 14 years, and the network is part of a wider programme spanning applications, digitalisation and AI.
bullets: Saudi German Health UAE selected HPE's wired, wireless NAC solution managed via HPE Aruba Central to modernize its network infrastructure; HPE and Saudi German Health UAE have partnered for 14 years

The network supports expansion of its hospitals, clinics, medical education facilities and new medical college in the UAE, as part of a broader program spanning infrastructure, networks, applications, digitalization and AI implementation
The deployment uses HPE Aruba Networking Access Points, HPE Networking CX Switches, Gateway Series, ClearPass Policy Manager and User Experience Insight
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: HPE (a direct competitor) is using networking to anchor a hospital group with a KSA parent. Lenovo's healthcare play (clinical devices, edge and hybrid cloud) should target Saudi German Health's KSA hospitals before HPE extends the footprint.
stories.arabic: مستشفيات السعودي الألماني في الإمارات تعتمد شبكات HPE ذاتية التشغيل لتحديث الرعاية الصحية الرقمية.

stories.title: e& UAE launches U6GHz network with speeds up to 10 Gbps
stories.source: Telecompaper 29 Sep 13:46 KSA; GCC Business News dated 29 Sep.
stories.published: Telecompaper 29 Sep 13:46 KSA; GCC Business News dated 29 Sep.
stories.summary: e& says the network is commercially live on 6425–6775 MHz (350 MHz) using 256TRX Giga-MIMO, engineered for up to 10 Gbps down and 1 Gbps up. The "world's first" claim was already made in April and June; today's news is the commercial go-live.
bullets: e& UAE has launched the world's first commercial mobile network using Upper 6GHz (U6GHz) 256TRX Giga-MIMO technology
The network operates across the 6425–6775 MHz range with 350 MHz of continuous bandwidth, delivering single-user peak speeds up to 10 Gbps downlink and 1 Gbps uplink
Single-cell throughput capacity exceeds 50 Gbps, with site-level coverage comparable to existing 3.5 GHz C-band infrastructure
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: U6GHz raises the bar for 5G-Advanced devices (Motorola) and edge capacity. Radio vendors are undisclosed (Huawei, Nokia and Honor were named partners in April).
stories.arabic: إي آند الإمارات تطلق تجارياً شبكة U6GHz بسرعات تصل إلى 10 غيغابت في الثانية.

stories.title: “قرة إنرجي” توقع شراكة استراتيجية مع “TMEIC” لحلول مراكز البيانات
stories.published: Al Borsa (Arabic), 29 Sep 2026. Mubasher carried it at about 10:40 KSA.
stories.summary: Egypt's Qura Energy signed a strategic partnership with TMEIC (Toshiba Mitsubishi-Electric) to supply advanced UPS systems to hyperscale data centres and heavy industry, locally and regionally. No value or MW disclosed. Qura recently listed on the EGX main market via a EGP 735 million IPO and targets EGP 9.5 billion in total business volume by year-end.
bullets: وقعت شركة قرة لمشروعات الطاقة والاستثمار «قرة إنرجي» عقد شراكة استراتيجية مع شركة «توشيبا ميتسوبيشي إلكتريك» لأنظمة الطاقة الصناعية (TMEIC) لتوفير حلول تكنولوجية متطورة وأنظمة طاقة مستدامة
يشمل محور مراكز البيانات توريد أنظمة متطورة لعدم انقطاع التيار الكهربائي (UPS) عالية الموثوقية لتقليص استهلاك الطاقة وخفض تكاليف التبريد والتشغيل بمراكز البيانات الضخمة
تأتي الشراكة عقب إدراج أسهم الشركة في السوق الرئيسية بالبورصة عبر طرح أولي بقيمة 735 مليون جنيه، وتستهدف زيادة حجم أعمالها الإجمالي إلى 9.5 مليار جنيه بنهاية العام الجاري
stories.lenovo: ISG: Egypt's DC power chain is localising ahead of the national DC strategy. It is a partner lead for Lenovo Egypt's integrated AI-factory bids (power plus Neptune).
stories.arabic: قرة إنرجي المصرية تتحالف مع TMEIC لتوريد أنظمة الطاقة غير المنقطعة لمراكز البيانات الضخمة محلياً وإقليمياً.

stories.title: Nvidia, AMD want Trump to keep their chips flowing to China
stories.published: Politico, 29 Sep 2026 11:45 KSA (byline, read in the browser).
stories.summary: NVIDIA and AMD are lobbying the White House and senior Commerce officials to keep China chip-export limits out of the NDAA. Their top target is AI OVERWATCH Act language; they see the Chip Security Act's chip-location tracking requirement as fixable. Jensen Huang joins a White House AI meeting on 29 Sep. NDAA talks are expected after the November election.
bullets: Nvidia and AMD are lobbying the Trump administration, including the White House and senior levels of the Commerce Department, to stop lawmakers from curbing their exports to China, according to three people granted anonymity

Their ask is that the administration pressure lawmakers to hold off from enacting China-related chip export restrictions in the annual defense policy bill, where the proposed limits have bipartisan support

The companies' top target is language pulled from the AI OVERWATCH Act, while they see better prospects to amend other measures including the Chip Security Act, which would require companies to track where certain chips end up
stories.lenovo: ISG: a chip-tracking mandate would reach server OEMs shipping GPUs into the Gulf, adding compliance cost and delay to HUMAIN, G42 and neocloud deliveries. ISG trade compliance should model it now.
stories.arabic: إنفيديا وAMD تضغطان على إدارة ترامب لإبقاء قيود تصدير الرقائق وتتبعها خارج قانون الدفاع الوطني، بما قد يؤثر على شحنات الخليج.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows sweeping AI vision, surging costs
stories.published: Reuters exclusive, 28 Sep 2026 23:17 GMT = 29 Sep 02:17 KSA (Google News). CNBC and FT followed.
stories.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic's prospectus shows 2025 revenue of nearly $4.6bn (12-fold growth), an operating loss of more than $8bn, and a net loss of $42bn including a roughly $34bn accounting charge. Compute and infrastructure spend was $7.33bn (3x 2024). The listing could value Anthropic at more than $2 trillion. It also lists $518bn in future cloud, compute and infrastructure commitments. The IPO is now likely after the US midterms.
bullets: Anthropic's revenue grew 12-fold in 2025 to nearly $4.6 billion, even as the company lost more than $8 billion on an operating basis, excluding writedowns, and reported a net loss of $42 billion including a roughly $34 billion accounting charge
The AI lab spent $7.33 billion on compute and infrastructure last year, a threefold surge from 2024, and plans to spend $518 billion on cloud, computing and infrastructure obligations
The public sale could value Anthropic at more than $2 trillion, with its market debut likely to be pushed to after the November US midterm elections
stories.lenovo: ISG: frontier-lab compute commitments at this scale keep GPU, HBM and server supply tight through 2027. That is the root cause behind items 28–30.
stories.arabic: نشرة اكتتاب أنثروبيك تكشف التزامات حوسبة وبنية تحتية مستقبلية بقيمة 518 مليار دولار وخسائر صافية كبيرة في 2025.

stories.title: Samsung Commits $1 Billion to Helix Digital Infrastructure to Support Global AI Infrastructure Buildout
stories.published: KKR / Business Wire, 29 Sep 2026 02:00 KSA (Yahoo syndication timestamp).
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics commits $500m, with Samsung C&T, SDS, SDI, Samsung Life and Samsung Fire & Marine adding $500m. This comes on top of more than $10bn already committed by KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority, NVIDIA and Vistra. Helix is led by former AWS CEO Adam Selipsky and has named no projects.
bullets: Samsung has committed $1 billion to Helix, an AI infrastructure company formed by KKR to help meet the growing infrastructure needs of hyperscalers, through its long-duration capital fund

The investment builds on the more than $10 billion of capital committed to the Helix strategy at its launch by founding investors including KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA), NVIDIA and Vistra
Helix expects to explore opportunities to leverage Samsung's capabilities across advanced technology, construction, energy storage and cooling to support AI infrastructure at scale
stories.lenovo: ISG: a new hyperscale developer is backed by GCC sovereign money (KIA) and a memory maker. Watch for a META site, and whether Samsung memory allocation follows the capital.

stories.title: Server DDR5 RDIMM Prices Surge Past $2,000
stories.published: BusinessKorea (Shin So-hyeon), 29 Sep 2026 18:59 KST = 12:59 KSA (page metadata).
stories.summary: Citing DRAMeXchange data, the DDR5 RDIMM 32GB 4800/5600 weekly average spot price was $2,050. Lead times for high-capacity RDIMMs are up to 52 weeks. That print is for the week of 14 Sep, up 7.9% week on week (range $1,950–2,380). It was $1,800 on 31 Aug and $1,900 on 7 Sep, about 5.4 times the ~$380 level of Nov 2025. Caveat: the latest data point is mid-September, not a new print.
bullets: The spot price of DDR5 RDIMM 32GB averaged $2,050 in the second week of September, with a weekly high of $2,380, more than fivefold in about 10 months from the high $300 range in November of last year.
The average price rose from $1,800 on Aug. 31 to $2,050 on Sept. 14, a 13.9% increase in just two weeks, while lead times for high-capacity DDR5 RDIMMs have extended up to 52 weeks.
The total DRAM market reached $154.73 billion in Q2 2026, up 59.5% from the previous quarter, and Q3 server DRAM contract prices are forecast to rise 13% to 18% quarter on quarter.
stories.lenovo: ISG: a 16-DIMM server now carries over $30k of memory alone. ISG META quotes must use short validity and memory indexation, or margins erode between quote and PO.
stories.arabic: سعر وحدة ذاكرة الخوادم DDR5 RDIMM سعة 32 غيغابايت يتجاوز 2000 دولار، أي نحو 5.4 أضعاف مستواه في نوفمبر 2025.

stories.title: HBM Supply Constraints Persist, 2027 Price Outlook Revised Upward with Blended ASP Forecast to Rise 121% YoY, Says TrendForce
stories.published: TrendForce Press Center, 29 Sep 2026 (Taipei). No time is shown, but any 29 Sep Taipei time up to 20:44 is in window, and it was live when checked at 13:10 KSA.
stories.summary: TrendForce forecasts the 2027 HBM blended ASP up 121% YoY on a higher HBM4 mix and the HBM4e ramp in 2H27. GPU/ASIC vendors are weighing 8-Hi instead of 12-Hi stacks because of supply and cost. 8-Hi is forecast about 10–20% more expensive per Gb. HBM and conventional DRAM compete for the same wafers through 2027.
bullets: TrendForce raised its 2027 HBM forecast on persistent supply constraints, a larger share of premium HBM4 and the gradual introduction of HBM4e in 2H27, with blended ASP projected to jump 121% YoY.
Continued expansion in AI server demand is keeping HBM and conventional DRAM in competition for limited advanced-process and wafer capacity, keeping supply tight through 2027.

GPU and ASIC makers are considering reducing HBM capacity per device and prioritizing 8-Hi configurations in 2027, which are expected to carry a roughly 10–20% price premium per Gb over 12-Hi products.
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: AI server BOMs rise again in 2027, and wafer competition keeps conventional DRAM (PCs and servers) tight. Plan 2027 META pricing assumptions accordingly (estimate, TrendForce).
stories.arabic: تريندفورس ترفع توقعاتها لأسعار ذاكرة HBM في 2027 بارتفاع متوسط 121% على أساس سنوي مع استمرار قيود الإمدادات.

He said HBM and standard DRAM compete for the same wafer capacity. TrendForce, citing the Seoul Economic Daily, adds Samsung HBM wafer input rising about 40% to ~250k per month.
bullets: Samsung Electronics Executive Vice President Kim Taewoo said HBM is expected to represent nearly 30% of DRAM chipmakers' total wafer capacity next year, up from about 20% currently.
HBM and standard DRAM compete for the same wafer capacity.
The HBM market is led by South Korea's SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, as well as US-based Micron Technology.
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: this is the supply-side confirmation that standard DRAM for PCs and mainstream servers stays constrained in 2027. It supports locking allocation now.

bullets: AMD's full EPYC 9006 Venice pricing list, obtained by StorageReview, spans SKUs from eight to 256 cores priced from $700 to $14,904.

The flagship SP7 part, the 256-core EPYC 9996, costs $14,904 or $58.21 per core, versus about $125.12 per core for the 64-core EPYC 9556 at $8,008; SP7 supports 16 memory channels up to DDR5-12800 and 96 PCIe 6.0 lanes.

stories.summary: Baird analyst Tristan Gerra raised his Micron target to $1,520 from $1,280. His estimates: industry DRAM supply growth of about 20% in 2027 (down from over 30% in 2026), and DRAM contract prices +20% QoQ in Q3 and +10% QoQ in Q4. Separately, JPMorgan (analyst not named) holds Overweight with a $1,540 target; consensus FQ4 is revenue $51.4bn, GM 86.2% and EPS $31.73 (estimates). Micron reports 30 Sep after the US close.
bullets: Baird analyst Tristan Gerra lifted his Micron price objective to $1,520 from $1,280 while retaining a Buy rating, ahead of the company's Sept. 30 earnings release.
Gerra expects AI-related CPU demand to increase about 40% in 2027, with server deployments using AMD and Intel CPUs lifting DRAM demand.
He sees DRAM supply growth slowing to around 20% next year from more than 30% in 2026, and expects DRAM contract prices to rise 20% sequentially in the September quarter and another 10% in December.
